purpose: Supplemental qualitative QC statement only. Original per-image check dictionaries, verdicts and ledger schema are unchanged; this does not retrospectively add a ninth scored check.
evidenceBasis: The renewal individually inspected all114 actual full-resolution delivered WebPs and all114 actual320x240 light/dark examples against their canonical action/state. This statement applies that actual inspection to the83 retained exact bytes, rather than deriving visual quality from a prior approval label. Four representative contact sheets were refreshed while writing this statement; this is not claimed as another full114-image inspection.
judgment: The83 retained examples satisfy the functional minimal explanatory-art requirement within their existing bounded canonical scopes: the equipment and relevant action/state dominate; no competing unrelated props, embedded instruction paragraphs or scenic narrative distract from the task; critical equipment geometry and relevant contact/liquid paths remain legible at phone size. No additional concrete failure of action focus or critical-geometry legibility was identified among those83.
styleQualification: Many retained images use richer tactile shading and a dark organic backing shape. They are not uniformly flat, decoration-free transparent editorial illustrations, and this statement does not certify identical style to the replacements or compliance with a later production prompt that prohibits backing islands. The retained backing shapes frame rather than obscure the teaching content; stylistic difference alone was not treated as a correctness rejection.
limits: The83 approvals remain limited to the exact canonical physical profiles and depicted state/subaction recorded per image; this statement does not expand any binding.
This is not a renewed generation-provenance audit, native app layout/accessibility inspection or physical brewing validation.
The31 rejected images remain rejected; focused composition does not excuse their mechanical/action failures.
